profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built Docker Images for Aible’s error tracking system and designed AWS resources using Cloudformation Template to deploy it, which enhanced management and performance via Infrastructure as code.
• Created new table designs that store customer’s personal data ensuring security of PII and optimizing queries.
• Managed workflows using REST API to extract data from Salesforce as input of Aible product interface in Python and
transfer output to customer’s Aible account.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Retrieved sentiment analysis using PostgreSQL in NodeJS categorized according to different key words
• Contributed in new functionality that allows authorized clients to have access to sentiment analysis of specified dates and locations which is then rendered using React
• Designed the architecture of the mobile application with React Native from scratch
• Implemented authorization process using Passport for both frontend and backend

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•  Added auto layout constraints to support rendering on various iOS devices
•  Rebranding the app by modifying UI layout to new designs
•  Using AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud storage built spotify-like music features using Apple’s AV media player
•  Integrate AWS (Amazon Web Services) to iOS app to use its own cloud database and notification services

positions.title: Structures and Interpretations of Computer Programs Academic Intern
positions.description:
• Advised students on which algorithms to use to efficiently approach various kinds of assignments
• Reinforced students’ knowledge in the structure and interpretation of computer programs, such as 
  data abstraction,
  recursion, and object oriented programming using Python

company.name: UC Berkeley Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS)

projects.title: TestAcer
projects.description:
• Added new constraints and changing design of the app and paths of storyboards and UIViewControllers to avoid merging conflicts and other issues.
• Used Firebase as the application’s cloud database, containing users’ and posts’ information.

projects.title: Pintos Project
projects.description:
• Designed a simple Pintos system in C
• Implemented synchronization of processes, file allocation systems, and cache using semaphores and locks and built an
efficient scheduler for all active/idle threads
• Added process control system calls such as creating child processes and file operation system calls
• Built buffer cache which is used to access files with optimal file allocation system

allTitles: Structures and Interpretations of Computer Programs Academic Intern
